_comment: KHÔNG CHỈNH SỬA: TỆP ĐƯỢC TẠO BỞI STACLOUD - TROLYAMAZON
name: Bun Generic
author: stacloud.dev@gmail.com
description: Bun Generic Egg cho STACloud — chi giu Bun latest stable, chay ung dung JavaScript/TypeScript tu Git repo hoac file upload.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Shared Git handling for the Code Languages eggs.
stacloud_git_sync() (
    mode=${1:-startup}
    if [ "$mode" = install ] && { [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = 1 ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = true ]; }; then
        echo 'STACloud: Git installation skipped (USER_UPLOAD=1).'
        exit 0
    fi
    if [ "$mode" = startup ] && [ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-0}" != 1 ]; then
        exit 0
    fi
    repo=${GIT_ADDRESS:-}
    if [ -z "$repo" ] && [ -e .git ]; then
        repo=$(git config --get remote.origin.url) || exit 1
    fi
    if [ -z "$repo" ]; then
        echo 'STACloud: No Git repository configured; using uploaded files.'
        exit 0
    fi
    # Remove legacy credentials before Git can log or persist the URL.
    if [[ "$repo" != https://* ]]; then
        echo 'STACloud: Git repository must use HTTPS.' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    authority=${repo#https://}
    authority=${authority%%/*}
    repo="https://${authority##*@}/${repo#https://$authority/}"
    if [[ ! "$repo" =~ ^https://[^/?#@[:space:]]+/[^?#[:space:]]+$ ]] || [[ "$repo" == *://*://* ]]; then
        echo 'STACloud: Git repository must be a valid HTTPS URL without query parameters.' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    repo=${repo%/}
    repo=${repo%.git}.git
    if [ ! -e .git ] && [ "$mode" = startup ] && { [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = 1 ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD:-0}" = true ]; }; then
        echo 'STACloud: AUTO_UPDATE needs a Git checkout; USER_UPLOAD=1 prevents cloning. Set USER_UPLOAD=0 to download the repository.' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    askpass=$(mktemp) || exit 1
    trap 'rm -f "$askpass"' EXIT
    chmod 700 "$askpass" || exit 1
    printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'case "$1" in *Username*) printf "%s\n" "${USERNAME:-x-access-token}" ;; *Password*) printf "%s\n" "${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}" ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac' > "$askpass" || exit 1
    export GIT_ASKPASS="$askpass" GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 LC_ALL=C
    export USERNAME ACCESS_TOKEN
    git_current() { git -c credential.helper= -c core.askPass="$askpass" -c http.extraHeader= "$@"; }
    if [ -e .git ]; then
        origin=$(git config --get remote.origin.url) || { echo 'STACloud: Git origin is missing.' >&2; exit 1; }
        origin_authority=${origin#https://}
        origin_authority=${origin_authority%%/*}
        origin="https://${origin_authority##*@}/${origin#https://$origin_authority/}"
        origin=${origin%/}
        origin=${origin%.git}.git
        if [ "$origin" != "$repo" ]; then
            echo 'STACloud: Configured repository differs from Git origin. Refusing to overwrite existing files.' >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        git config remote.origin.url "$repo" || exit 1
        if [ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
            current_branch=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD) || exit 1
            if [ "$current_branch" != "$BRANCH" ]; then
                echo 'STACloud: Configured branch differs from the current checkout. Refusing to switch branches automatically.' >&2
                exit 1
            fi
        fi
        echo 'STACloud: Updating Git repository with current credentials.'
        git_current pull --ff-only origin ${BRANCH:+"$BRANCH"} || {
            echo 'STACloud: Git pull failed. Check the Git error above, token repository access, branch, and local changes. Application will not start.' >&2
            exit 1
        }
    else
        if [ -n "$(ls -A .)" ]; then
            echo 'STACloud: Directory contains files but no Git checkout. Refusing to overwrite uploaded files.' >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        echo 'STACloud: Cloning Git repository with current credentials.'
        if [ -n "${BRANCH:-}" ]; then
            git_current clone --single-branch --branch "$BRANCH" -- "$repo" . || { echo 'STACloud: Git clone failed; application will not start.' >&2; exit 1; }
        else
            git_current clone -- "$repo" . || { echo 'STACloud: Git clone failed; application will not start.' >&2; exit 1; }
        fi
    fi
)

stacloud_git_sync install || exit 1
echo "STACloud: Git installation complete; dependencies are installed on startup."

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description:
What branch to pull from github.

Default is blank to pull the repo default branch

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: 1 skips Git installation and initial cloning; use uploaded files. Set 0 to download the repository. AUTO_UPDATE can update an existing Git checkout in either mode.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the Git repository on startup using the current username/token. Git failures stop startup. Public repos do not require credentials.

variables.name: Main File
variables.description:
The file or script name that starts the App.

E.g. index.ts, src/index.js, or a package.json script name like start

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token used for Git installation and startup updates. Private GitHub repositories require Contents read access. The token is not saved in the remote URL.
